name: Aminoguanidine bicarbonate
description: Aminoguanidine bicarbonate (CAS 2582-30-1 ), also known as aminoguanidinium bicarbonate, is the stable salt form of aminoguanidine, preferred for handling and storage over the free base. It functions as a reactive intermediate and stabilizer across pharmaceutical synthesis, polymer processing, and agrochemical manufacturing. In pharmaceutical production, it serves as a key building block. It is used for synthesizing triazines, guanazoles, and other nitrogen-heterocyclic compounds used in active ingredient development. Polymer manufacturers use it as a stabilizer and antioxidant precursor. In polyurethane and resin systems, it helps inhibit oxidative degradation during processing. In agrochemical formulations, it contributes to preservative and biocidal activity in various products. It is particularly effective in products targeting microbial and fungal threats. It also functions as a pH buffer and catalyst precursor in specialty chemical synthesis where controlled reactivity is required. Aminoguanidine bicarbonate is supplied as a white crystalline powder. Standard commercial grades include technical and pharmaceutical-grade material, with purity specifications typically ranging from 98% to 99%+. Packaging is available in kilogram-scale bags through to bulk quantities to support both R&D procurement and industrial-scale sourcing. This ensures reliable supply for diverse manufacturing needs.
